title: mini spatulas
text: mini spatulas. I only needed a couple of these, but the price was so good for 12 (you get 12 mini spatulas of various colors) that I decided to order and donate the extra.  I kept 3 donated the rest.  They are just a handy size that I find I need when I use my muffin cups to bake something in... or small jars.  They say safe up to 460 degrees or so.  I hand wash, but I think they could be washed in a dishwasher.  I have a flat basket above the top basket of my dishwasher that they would easily fit in to wash that way.
